# Current measured baseline — this is your starting point, not 364/24

| Gate | Measured now |
|---|---|
| G1 `npx tsc --noEmit` | **0** |

The 367/25 already includes the earlier fixes' additions (a restored check that the style-code label is genuinely sourced through `formatMessage`, and a new `zimmProductName/index.test.tsx` covering the guard that fix 4 added).

---

# FIX 3 — `recipeParts.test.ts` carries a false cross-reference

`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts:15-16` currently reads:
> *"Scope: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/**`. Recipes elsewhere are covered by `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`."*

**That is false, verified.** `recipeGuards.test.ts` has **no** parts-vs-reads check of any kind — its only `parts` occurrences are a spacing-token splitter at `:321-322` and a namespacing comment at `:350`. So these three are unguarded while the comment claims otherwise:
- `overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts`
- `overrides/app/components/footer/footerNavColumn/footerNavColumn.css.ts`
- `overrides/app/components/footer/bottomBar/bottomBar.css.ts`

All three declare `parts:` (verified).

**Preferred: widen the walk root to `overrides/app/components` so they are genuinely covered, and correct the docstring.** Expect **+3 test cases**.

**⚠️ The escape hatch, and I mean it.** If widening turns the gate red — because a footer recipe declares a part its component never reads — **do not force it, do not edit the footer recipe, and do not narrow the check to make it pass.** That is a genuine finding about already-merged #59 code and it is not yours to fix here. In that case: revert to correcting the docstring only, stating plainly that recipes outside `ui-kits/` are **not** covered, and **report the failing recipe and the specific unread part**. Both outcomes are fully acceptable. Say which you took and why.

The auditor also noted `READ_RE` only recognises the identifier `styles`, so `zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:37,97`'s `chrome.actions` destructuring is invisible to it. Broaden the regex **only if** you are already widening successfully and it does not destabilise the gate. If broadening surfaces new failures, treat it the same way — report, don't force.

# FIX 5 — one line

`overrides/app/theme/index.test.tsx`'s `component overrides are registered` test pins `ZimmProductMeta`, `ZimmProductName`, `ZimmProductModelInfo`. **Add `ZimmProductPrice` to that existing test.**

Why it matters: it currently has no registration pin, no `.css.test.ts`, no `play`, and its own test asserts only text content and ARIA — so unregistering its recipe is invisible at every layer. **Do not create a new test** — add the assertion to the existing block, so this is **+0 tests**.

The existing comment there explains the reasoning for the three already pinned (an unregistered recipe resolves to `{}` silently, and for colour-only atoms the inherited fallback differs from the brand value by ~1 unit per channel). If the comment now misdescribes the set, correct it.

# FIX 6 — one story

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.stories.tsx` never exercises `isProductPartOfBundle: true` — it is `false` at roughly `:65` and `:95`, and omitted at `:114`, with only an `argTypes` control declared.

So the two branches whose in-file comments justify their existence — the price gate at roughly `staticProductHeader.tsx:88-90` (*"without this the price would be the one part of that header which stopped being gated"*) and the promo gate just below it — have **zero** mechanical coverage.

**Add a fourth story with `isProductPartOfBundle: true`**, asserting that the price is absent **and** the promo callout is absent, while the name and description still render. Match the file's existing story shape and naming register.

Expect **G4 105 → 106 stories**, files unchanged at 24.

---

# Gates — declare your deltas, then reconcile

| Gate | Required |
|---|---|
| G1 | **0** |
| G2 | **367 + F3 / 25** — F3 is **+3** if widening holds, **+0** if you take the escape hatch. F5 and F6 are both +0. Files stay **25**. |
| G3 | **17 err / 15 warn** |
| G4 | **106 / 24** — **REBUILD REQUIRED**, and `a11y: { test: 'error' }` means every story is an axe assertion, so your new one must pass |
| G5 | **14 unack / 22 ack** |

Read counts, not exit codes: G3 and G5 both exit 1 at a healthy baseline. For G4, bind port 0 to get a free port, serve `storybook-static` with `python3 -m http.server`, and pass `--url` — do not run `test-storybook` bare.

# Do NOT

- Touch anything fixes 1, 2 or 4 changed. If you believe one of them is wrong, **report it, do not edit it.**
- Edit any `footer/**` recipe or component. See fix 3's escape hatch.
- Touch `translations/`, `theme/foundation/`, test config, `package.json`, or `scripts/`.
- Commit, stage, stash, or touch any git ref.
- Append args to `npm run lint`. `lint:fix` / `pwa-kit-dev format` forbidden.
- Run `npm start`. Install packages. Change any design value.

Restore a single file: `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` — **but note that reverts to `3920caf`, which for the four files fixes 1/2/4 touched would destroy that work.** The three files you are editing were not touched by the earlier builder, so `git checkout HEAD --` is safe for those specifically. Verify before using it.

# Standing rules — all earned in this sequence

- **Locate by content; report `brief says :N, found at :M`.** Every number here has drifted at least once.
- **Mutation-prove every new or changed assertion** — flip it, watch it fail, restore. Prove `tsc` checks a file with an **undeclared identifier**, never a bad Chakra token (a typo'd responsive key type-checks clean).
- **Name mutation backups by full-path slug, never `basename`** — a collision destroyed a file earlier in this run.
- **Every claim in a comment must be true of observable state.** Fix 3 exists precisely because that was violated; five such comments have now been found in this work, two of them claims I supplied.
- **Instruction refusal authorised** — report `REFUSED: <instruction> — <why> — <what I did instead>`.
- **Treat every claim in this brief as CLAIMED.** Thirteen of my assertions have been caught wrong in this run — including one where I "corrected" a statement that had been right.

# Report back

1. Declared deltas, then reconciled term by term.
2. Each fix: final `file:line`, and the re-location table.
3. **Fix 3: which option you took. If you widened — did all three footer recipes pass? If you took the escape hatch — which recipe, which unread part?**
4. Your mutation proof for every new/changed assertion.
5. The five gate numbers, G3 warnings and G5 acknowledged explicit, plus confirmation you rebuilt Storybook on a port obtained by binding 0.
6. `git diff --stat` + `git status --short`.
7. Anything noticed, not fixed. Any `REFUSED:`.

     2	
     3	/**
     4	 * Recipe for the product name.

     6	 * Single-part, so no `parts` key and the component reads it through `useStyleConfig` — the same
     7	 * shape as `zimmProductPrice.css.ts` and `zimmProductDescription.css.ts`.
     8	 *
     9	 * The whole declaration is one colour, which was previously a `color="text.default"` prop on the
    10	 * component. That resolved correctly, but a bare Chakra token key is what overrideStyling.md's
    11	 * hierarchy point 2 rules out, and `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` can only mechanically
    12	 * catch the mistake inside a registered recipe — its own SCOPE note says it cannot see a JSX
    13	 * prop. Moving the value here puts it under that guard.
    14	 *
    15	 * Type is set here too, for the same reason the colour is. A `textStyle` left on the JSX element
    16	 * would land in `styleProps`, which `@chakra-ui/system`'s `toCSSObject` assigns *after* `__css`
    17	 * (`assignAfter({}, __css, finalBaseStyle, filterUndefined(styleProps), sx)`, dist/index.js
    18	 * lines 204-213) — so any future variant setting `fontSize`/`lineHeight`/`fontWeight` would
    19	 * resolve into `__css` and then be overwritten by the element's own prop. Declared in the recipe
    20	 * it is merged by `useStyleConfig` ahead of the variant instead, so a variant can override it.
    21	 * `textStyle` stays a bare key by design: it is a composite with no single `var(--zimm-*)`
    22	 * equivalent, and overrideStyling.md's hierarchy point 1 names it the correct form for type.
    23	 */
    24	export const ZimmProductName = {
    25	  baseStyle: {
    26	    // Explicit rather than inherited from Chakra's preflight. This element is a heading, and
    27	    // `ZimmProductContent`'s rhythm is a container `gap` that any child margin would sit on top
    28	    // of — `index.stories.tsx` there asserts `marginTop === '0px'` on every child for exactly
    29	    // that reason. Stated here so a future preflight change cannot reintroduce it.
    30	    margin: 0,
    31	    color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
    32	    textStyle: 'heading3',
    33	  } satisfies SystemStyleObject,
    34	};

     7	 * shape as `zimmProductPrice.css.ts` and `zimmProductDescription.css.ts`.
     8	 *
     9	 * As with `zimmProductName.css.ts`, this exists to move one colour off a
    10	 * `color="text.default"` JSX prop and into a registered recipe, where
    11	 * `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` can actually see it — that guard walks the registered
    12	 * recipe map only and cannot reach a component's props.
    13	 *
    14	 * Type is declared here too, not as a `textStyle=` on the element. `@chakra-ui/system`'s
    15	 * `toCSSObject` assigns `styleProps` *after* `__css` (`assignAfter({}, __css, finalBaseStyle,
    16	 * filterUndefined(styleProps), sx)`, dist/index.js lines 204-213), so an element prop out-ranks

    21	 * does not spec would be a design decision taken in the wrong place.

    24	  baseStyle: {
    25	    // Same reason as zimmProductName.css.ts: the wrapper is a `div` holding parsed rich text,
    26	    // so its own box must not contribute a margin to a parent that spaces with `gap`.
    27	    margin: 0,

     1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
     2	
     3	/**
     4	 * Recipe for the PDP price.
     5	 *
     6	 * The DS models `pdp/price` with two states, so this carries a `variants` map rather than a
     7	 * bare `baseStyle` — see .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md tier 3. Only `default` is populated:
     8	 * the was/now (sale) treatment belongs to SFCC-194, and its colours and strike-through are not
     9	 * specced anywhere we can read today. Adding a `sale` key that merely echoes `default` would
    10	 * look finished and be wrong, so the extension point is documented instead of stubbed.
    11	 *
    12	 * SFCC-194 adds `sale` alongside `default` below; nothing else in this file needs to change.
    13	 *
    14	 * That last sentence is only true because `textStyle` is declared in `baseStyle` below rather
    15	 * than left on the JSX element. `@chakra-ui/system`'s `toCSSObject` resolves
    16	 * `assignAfter({}, __css, finalBaseStyle, filterUndefined(styleProps), sx)` (dist/index.js lines
    17	 * 204-213), so `styleProps` — an element's own `textStyle=` — is applied *after* `__css`, which
    18	 * is where a recipe's resolved styles arrive. A `sale` variant setting `fontSize`, `lineHeight`
    19	 * or `fontWeight` would therefore have been silently overwritten by the element's prop. Declared
    20	 * here, `useStyleConfig` merges base then variant, so the variant wins as intended.
    21	 */
    22	export const ZimmProductPrice = {
    23	  baseStyle: {
    24	    margin: 0,
    25	    color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
    26	    textStyle: 'price',
    27	  } satisfies SystemStyleObject,
    28	
    29	  variants: {
    30	    default: {} satisfies SystemStyleObject,
    31	  },
    32	
    33	  defaultProps: {
    34	    variant: 'default',
    35	  },
    36	};
